response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage AS phase, AVG(station_avg_bandwidth) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count FROM station_stats GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT phase, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_fraction FROM phase_stats
